title: Food Foreign-Material Detection Equipment Verification Record
description: Evidence model for shift-opening and periodic verification of metal-detection and X-ray inspection equipment used on food processing lines to detect and reject foreign-material contaminants (ferrous/non-ferrous metal, stainless steel, glass, dense plastic). This is a HACCP prerequisite program (21 CFR 117 Subpart B / Codex CAC/RCP 1-1969) and is distinct from HACCP-CCP process-control monitoring: CCP records control a process parameter at a critical control point, whereas this record verifies the detection/rejection equipment itself is capable of isolating the hazard.

line_id.description: Processing line identifier where the detection equipment is installed

test_piece_ferrous_verified.description: Ferrous test-piece successfully detected and rejected

test_piece_nonferrous_verified.description: Non-ferrous test-piece successfully detected and rejected

test_piece_stainless_verified.description: Stainless-steel (non-magnetic) test-piece successfully detected and rejected

reject_confirm_tested.description: Reject mechanism (pusher/air-blast/diverter) confirmed to remove the test piece from the accept flow

line_stop_interlock_verified.description: Line-stop or alarm interlock verified to trigger on consecutive rejects or detector fault
